title: GVHMR original paper, sections 3.1–3.2
snippet: Gravity-view frame resolves orientation ambiguity; global translation is cumulative learned local displacement. Losses are supervised reconstruction and stationary labels, not explicit ballistic dynamics.

title: Author ground correction example
snippet: Axis conversion followed by linear fit to per-frame lowest vertex heights; not a contact-mode or ballistic solver.

title: GVHMR static-camera postprocessor
snippet: Lines 75,89–95 smooth incam, threshold mismatch by 0.25m per axis, cap each correction to +/-0.02m, accumulate it on later frames. Static-joint correction does not modify Y; final ground shift is global.
author: Named original authors or maintainers

title: GVHMR pipeline and training losses
snippet: Reads learned local translation velocity, rolls out global translation, chooses static-camera or regular postprocessing, then IK. Static labels are based on joint speed, not forces or explicit support geometry.
author: Named original authors or maintainers

title: GVHMR displacement encoding and rollout
snippet: Frame differences are rotated into SMPL space and decoded by cumulative sum; stationary labels use frame differences divided by 0.033, not arbitrary input FPS.
author: Named original authors or maintainers

title: KungFuAthleteBot, section 3.2
snippet: GVHMR/GMR-derived jump data is corrected through extrema, manual skip set, lowest-body ground anchoring and parabolic root interpolation. Formula samples inferred flight time into a fixed frame interval.

title: KungFuAthleteBot gravity adjustment implementation
snippet: fit_parabola_and_sample uses y0,y1,N,g but no source FPS; g cancels from the sampled heights algebraically. adjust_root_z includes skip=minidxes[-3], works on root not COM, and final call smooths qpos. Read as source, never executed.
